name: Loop
description: Custom updater; SecStaticCodeCheckValidity with nil requirement (no Team-ID pin) + SHA256 from same response.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: The recovered updater reads a GitHub asset SHA-256 digest and verifies the downloaded archive before privileged installation. The snapshot indicates a checksum plus OS signing-consistency check, but no pinned signer; primary tier remains unresolved.
limitations: This is a newly retrieved default-branch snapshot rather than the original study checkout; it does not certify current releases.

original_evidence.text: | Loop | https://github.com/MrKai77/Loop | **Custom in-house updater** (no Sparkle at all; only incidental hits for the word "sparkle" are an SF Symbol name `"sparkles"` and a code comment) | Y | Y (checks automatically on a schedule; downloads new build; then installs via a privileged XPC helper) | Y | https (`api.github.com` REST API + GitHub Releases asset/CDN URLs) | TLS-only (update "manifest" = raw GitHub Releases JSON over HTTPS; no cryptographic signature over the manifest itself) | checksum(SHA-256, value sourced from GitHub's own release-asset `digest` field in the same HTTPS response) **+** OS-code-signing check that validates internal signature consistency only, with **no anchor/Team-ID pinning** (`SecStaticCodeCheckValidity` called with a `nil` requirement) | none — no pinned public key anywhere; trust root is TLS to `api.github.com`/GitHub release CDN plus an un-pinned Apple code-signature validity check | `Loop/Updater/UpdaterModels.swift:30-34` — `githubReleasesEndpoint` = `https://api.github.com/repos/MrKai77/Loop/releases/latest` (stable) / `.../releases` (dev). `Loop/Updater/UpdateChecker.swift:80-101` — selects the `.zip` asset and extracts `asset.digest` (`sha256:...`) as the expected checksum straight from the same JSON payload. `Loop/Updater/Utilities/ChecksumVerifier.swift:16-27` — streams SHA-256 and does a plain string compare, throwing `UpdateError.checksumMismatch` on mismatch. `Loop/Updater/UpdateInstaller.swift:433-452` — `validateAppCodeSignature` creates a `SecStaticCode` and calls `SecStaticCodeCheckValidity(staticCode, validationFlags, nil)` — the `nil` third argument means no `SecRequirement` (e.g., anchor cert / Team ID) is enforced, so any validly-signed app (not necessarily signed by Loop's own developer identity) would pass this check. `Loop/Updater/UpdaterAuthorizationCoordinator.swift` implements a separate privileged-helper XPC install flow (`atomicSwap`, `restoreFromBackup`) for applying the update with elevated rights. |
